turns.question: What was the median order amount in EUR for non-cancelled orders placed in September 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no median order value metric, so I cannot give a median; the closest is Average order value (EUR), which is 114.39 EUR, a mean and not a median, over non-cancelled orders placed 1-30 September 2026. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
